header: This is the single source of truth for how I match a *quoted* query, so the SQL literal branch (semanticContentSearch), the JS isExactPhrase computation (route.ts) and the UI highlighter (searchUtils) all agree. OPTION 1 rules:
- Not quoted -> caller keeps its existing behaviour

Case-insensitive is deliberate: the corpus is OCR'd and case-noisy (e.g. "SHRAM BHAVAN" vs "Shram Bhavan"), so I fold case when matching. Quoting changes only one thing: whole-word instead of substring. Nothing here touches the vector path or the title fallback.

symbols.name: QuotedMode
symbols.sig: { isQuoted: boolean; phrase: string; wholeWord: boolean; }

symbols.name: isDoubleQuoted
doc: I ask here whether the raw query is wrapped in a matched pair of DOUBLE quotes.

doc: I classify a raw query here to decide how its literal branch should behave.
